Question 1

Which integral expression gives the arc length of the curve f(t)=⟨cos⁡t+sin⁡t,et,sin⁡t−cos⁡t⟩ from t=−1 to t=1?

a
∫−112et+1dt
b
∫−11e2t+1dt
c
2∫−11et+2dt
d
2∫−112e2t+1dt

∫−11e2t+2dt
